# Acceptance map

<!-- Generated by docs/specs/render-acceptance.py from docs/specs/features/*.md
     and docs/specs/acceptance-proofs.json. Do not edit this file by hand. -->

This map quotes each acceptance criterion of the approved spec, `docs/specs/features/*.md`.
For each criterion, it names the test, the doc section, the CI job or the committed file that proves it.
The text of each criterion is verbatim.
The script joins the wrapped lines of a criterion and removes the `[ ]` task-list marker.

The spec holds **414** acceptance criteria in 12 feature files.

To update the map, edit `docs/specs/acceptance-proofs.json`, then run this command:

```bash
python3 docs/specs/render-acceptance.py
```

The script fails when a criterion has no entry, or when a named test, section, job or file does not exist.

A test proof names the Go test function and the directory of its package.
To run one, use `go test ./<directory> -run '^<name>$'`.
Tests in `tests/interoperability` belong to a separate module: run them from that directory.

Each criterion below has no test, doc section, CI job or committed file that proves it.

| Feature | # | Criterion | Reason |
|---|---|---|---|
| Foundation | 22 | Each `uses:` line in `ci.yml` names a version that the action's README documents. (FR-foundation-25) | No check confirms that each uses: version appears in the README of the action. |
| Foundation | 23 | `git branch -r` lists `origin/dev`. (FR-foundation-26) | The branch is a property of the GitHub repository. No committed file or test shows it. |
| Foundation | 24 | The Epic 0 batch PR and every later batch PR target `dev`. (FR-foundation-27) | The PR base is a property of each GitHub PR. No committed check enforces it. |
| Embedded recovery demonstration | 27 | FR-demo-36: the code holds no call that writes outside the data directory and the state file. | No test or check scans the code for writes outside the data directory and the state file. |
| qmuxd daemon | 35 | FR-qmuxd-40, FR-qmuxd-41: `docker build .` succeeds, and the container runs as a user other than root and answers on port 53. | No test or CI job runs `docker build .`, and no file records the user of the container or port 53. |
| Interop harness | 24 | FR-interop-39a: `docker compose exec unbound unbound-checkconf` reports no error, and the forward zone for `fleet.example.` is active. | No test or results file shows the output of `unbound-checkconf`. |
| Interop harness | 25 | FR-interop-39b: a probe repeated after its TTL expires and after `qmuxd` stops shows outcome `rcode` or `timeout` on the `unbound` path, not a cached answer. | No test or results file shows a repeated probe after the TTL and a stopped `qmuxd` on the `unbound` path. |
| Baseline benchmarks | 9 | FR-bench-17: the server log shows no two lookups of one benchmark run in parallel. | No test or results file shows that one benchmark run has no two lookups in parallel. |
| Baseline benchmarks | 12 | FR-bench-20: at loss 100, a `coap` lookup records 3 transmissions of the request. | No test asserts 3 CoAP transmissions in 5 s; a test only logs the count and another shows 2 transmissions in 1.8 s. |
